title: Saving Overview edits switches the card back to read-only view with the new values, no reload required
steps: On /organization, click 'Edit Details', change Industry, click 'Save Changes'
expectedResult: Form collapses back to the read-only Organization Details view (isEditing=false) immediately, showing the newly entered Industry value pulled from the update response — no manual refresh needed.

title: Changing a user's role via AssignRoleModal updates the role shown on their row without a manual page refresh
description: TeamTab's handleStatusChange bumps userListKey (remounting UserList) and drawerRefreshKey after AssignRoleModal's onSuccess fires — quick check that this actually re-renders the row rather than showing stale role data until a hard refresh.
steps: Open a user's row, use 'Change Role' to assign a different role, confirm the change
expectedResult: The user's row in the team list immediately reflects the new role name/badge; the side drawer (if still open) also shows the updated role.

title: Resend Invite is rejected within the 60-second cooldown, quick UI-facing check
description: Fast confirmation of the user-facing effect of RESEND_INVITE_COOLDOWN_MS (user.controller.js resendInvite), complementing the backend unit test ORGM-UNIT-004 — this just checks the toast/error surfaces correctly in the UI within the window.
preconditions: A user with status 'Invited', invited less than 60 seconds ago
steps: From that user's row/drawer, click 'Resend Invite' immediately after the original invite
expectedResult: An error toast appears indicating an invite was just sent and to wait a minute — no second Keycloak invite email is triggered.

title: A custom role can be created with zero permissions selected
description: role.controller.js create() has no minimum-permission validation — permissions defaults to [] if neither permissions nor grid is supplied. Quick edge-case check that this doesn't throw, since an empty-permission role is a legitimate (if unusual) 'placeholder' role some admins create before configuring it.
steps: On /organization/roles, click 'Create Custom Role', enter a name only, leave every permission grid cell at 'none', save
expectedResult: Role is created successfully and appears as a Custom Roles card showing '0 permissions' — no validation error blocks the save.

title: Deleting a custom role removes its card from the grid immediately (optimistic local update)
description: RolesTab.handleDeleteConfirm does setRoles(prev => prev.filter(r => r._id !== deleteTarget._id)) locally after a successful DELETE, rather than re-fetching — quick check that this optimistic update matches server state (no ghost card, no card lingering after a slow network response).
steps: On /organization/roles, click 'Delete' on a custom role card, confirm in the dialog
expectedResult: The role's card disappears from the Custom Roles grid immediately after confirming, with a 'Role deleted' success toast; reloading the page confirms it does not reappear.
